settings.description: Larger retro-aesthetic box speaker designed to extend presence into a wider space. With increased output power and a dedicated 2-tweeter and 1-woofer setup, it delivers a fuller, more open sound that fills the room with greater depth and clarity. Ambient lighting enhances the atmosphere without distraction, while flexible connectivity options—Bluetooth, AUX, USB, and TF card—keep it adaptable to everyday use. Built-in EQ allows quick tuning for different moods, and an integrated microphone supports clear voice interaction directly from the device. With TWS pairing, two units can connect to form a wider stereo field, expanding both scale and sound beyond its physical form.
